notes.title: Moonbase 332 Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Return to Moonbase 332 with update 2.0. The update eliminates a lot of bugs, crashes and glitches. It also brings Moonbase 332 to Windows 10! To celebrate the update, enjoy an 80% discount on the game (Lunar Sale)! I will also be doing a Moonbase 332 Speedrun on Friday the 12th of February at 8pm (UTC). I will stream on [url=https://i.camefrom.space/ySJ3]Steam[/url] and [url=https://i.camefrom.space/7SI6]Twitch[/url] with [url=https://i.camefrom.space/snDH]RedKarellen[/url].

UPDATE: You can see a replay of the run here: [url=https://www.speedrun.com/moonbase332/run/zno782ly]https://www.speedrun.com/moonbase332/run/zno782ly[/url]

There is also a big change in the launcher: the DRM-free version now comes without a launcher. In addition, the entire Moonbase account system will be removed. All accounts already created will be deleted. The ranking now uses the official way via the Steam API. Further details can be found in the changelog.
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
 	[*]Added support for Windows 10[/*]
 	[*]Significant performance and stability improvement (Way fewer crashes! HYPE!)[/*]
 	[*]A completely rewritten launcher for the steam version (I lost the source code of the old one)[/*]
 	[*]Removed the launcher for the DRM-Free Version (Since the launcher is only responsible for communicating with Steam)[/*]
 	[*]Better Steam integration (No more bugged Achievements! YAY!)[/*]
 	[*]Old ranking system removed. Also, your special Moonbase 332 accounts. You no longer need them.[/*]
 	[*]High scores are now processed via Steam[/*]
 	[*]Added "random-texture-remover 9001"[/*]
[/list]
A big shoutout to s4real and Nomad. Without you, this update would not have been possible.
[h2]The Future[/h2]
It has taken a long time for this update to arrive, which is why I don't want to say too much about the future. But keep an eye out for ZombLabs. Maybe something will happen there in the next few months.

Stay healthy, stay at home, [url=https://i.camefrom.space/cs3p]play Moonbase 332[/url]!

notes.title: Moonbase 332 Update 1.3
notes.notes:
We will publish Update 1.3 this week. We have fixed some bugs and we have added a Chapter selection. Some players have problems with crashes and their savegames. With the chapter selection many crashes can be avoided. In addition, players are free to choose where they jump into the game. If players get stuck in one place then you can skip the level with the chapter selection. [ 35 more words. ]
http://patchnotestudio.com/moonbase-332-update-1-3/

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.1 is now online. We have fixed some bugs and we have increased the brightness of the game. The game should now be fully playable. (Fixed Error 118). Now you can also change the assignment of the keys. The tool is currently in beta. 

Update your game and go back to the Moonbase 332! We are constantly working on improvements. Stay tuned.
